verdict.rationale: GA4's own marketing page claims collaboration through "shareable reports", and a community member notes custom reports can be built in 'Explore', so sharing reports with a team is a product capability. Nothing documents composing saved insights into a multi-widget dashboard. The Data API 'build custom dashboards' line is a developer building block, and Looker Studio via BigQuery is a separate product, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: documented dashboard composition from saved insights/reports, team sharing and permission details, in-depth first-party docs on the reporting UI, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can compose saved insights into shareable dashboards for my team

citations.quote: Quickly analyze your data and collaborate with an easy-to-use interface and shareable reports.
